_note: The night's scenes, played on the board (Play.md 'Cutscenes'). Each shot: at (board, foyer, player, killer, fall), seconds, distance [from, to] in metres, yaw [from, to] in degrees around the target, tilt in degrees, the caption line, and a clip the shot's figure plays (talk, attack, power, hit or none). Lines may use {player}, {night} and {survivors}.

opening.line: Saigon, eight in the evening. The Opera House locks its doors behind its last guests.
Seven were invited. Only one will be let out.

midnight.line: Midnight. Somewhere below the stage, a bell nobody rang.
Something climbs out of the understage. It cannot be killed. Run.

dawn.line: Dawn, and the doors stay shut. {survivors} are still breathing.
The house rearranges itself. Night {night} begins.

ending_escaped.line: The last rival falls. The house goes quiet.
The doors open. {survivors} walks out into the Saigon morning, alone.

ending_house.line: No one is left alive. The theatre keeps its guests; the gala will be held again.
